security_audit.summary: No prompt injection, malicious network behavior, or data-exfiltration intent was found. Most external-command and blocker findings are false positives from markdown formatting, JavaScript template literals, comments, or PDF field identifiers; the confirmed findings are expected local filesystem reads and writes used for PDF processing.

remediation.suggestion: Validate output paths before writing PDFs, JSON files, images, or text files, and require confirmation before overwriting existing files.
Limit batch processing to explicit user-selected directories and document which files will be read before processing begins.
Keep command examples limited to explicit PDF utilities, quote paths with spaces, and avoid constructing shell commands from untrusted text.

content.value_statement: PDF work often needs extraction, conversion, form filling, and document assembly. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical PDF workflows.
actual_capabilities: Extracts text and tables from PDFs using pypdf and pdfplumber workflows.
Creates, merges, splits, rotates, crops, watermarks, and encrypts PDFs.
Guides fillable PDF form discovery, field extraction, validation, and filling.
Supports non-fillable forms with image conversion, bounding boxes, validation images, and text annotations.
Documents JavaScript options with pdf-lib and PDF.js examples.
Provides command-line workflows for pdftotext, qpdf, pdftk, and pdfimages.
limitations: It depends on installed Python libraries and external PDF tools.
Scanned PDFs require OCR tools such as Tesseract and image conversion.
Form annotation placement requires visual review to avoid incorrect coordinates.
Scripts read and write local files, so path handling remains important.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Forms
use_cases.description: Fill structured or scanned PDF forms while validating field placement before final output.

use_cases.title: Extract Document Data
use_cases.description: Pull text, tables, images, and metadata from PDF collections for review or analysis.

use_cases.title: Assemble Office Documents
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, watermark, crop, and protect PDF packets for routine office work.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract all readable text from this PDF. Preserve page order, summarize key sections, and note any pages that appear scanned.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a PDF Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this PDF has fillable fields. Extract field information, map my provided values, validate them, and create a filled PDF.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Non-Fillable Form Placement
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this non-fillable form to images, identify entry areas, create validation images, check bounding boxes, and add the requested text annotations.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Batch PDF Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a safe workflow to process every PDF in this folder, extract tables, save outputs, report failures, and avoid overwriting source files.

output_examples.input: User asks to extract tables from a financial PDF report.
output_examples.output: A list of detected tables by page, exported spreadsheet filenames, and notes for pages with weak table structure.

output_examples.input: User provides a benefits enrollment form and personal field values.
output_examples.output: A completed PDF form plus a short validation summary showing matched fields and unresolved entries.

output_examples.input: User asks to merge several PDF packets and add a watermark.
output_examples.output: A merged and watermarked PDF with a concise record of source order, page counts, and output path.

best_practices: Work on copies of source PDFs and keep originals unchanged.
Use explicit input and output paths for every script or command.
Inspect validation images before adding annotations to non-fillable forms.
anti_patterns: Do not run batch operations on broad directories without checking the file list.
Do not overwrite source PDFs with generated output files.
Do not trust extracted form fields without visual review for important documents.

faq.question: Can this skill fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports fillable fields and annotation-based workflows for non-fillable forms.

faq.question: Can it extract tables from PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pdfplumber workflows for table extraction and spreadsheet-style outputs.

faq.question: Does it work with scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, but scanned documents need image conversion and OCR tools for text extraction.

faq.question: Does it require external software?
faq.answer: Some workflows require Python packages, Poppler utilities, qpdf, pdftk, or OCR tools.

faq.question: Can it process many PDFs at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The reference includes batch processing patterns, but users should restrict input folders carefully.

faq.question: Does it send PDF data over the network?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The reviewed scripts use local files and only include documentation URLs in comments.
